notes.title: Quality of Life Update
notes.notes:
Patch Notes



 Mining Adjustments: Resources are now deposited gradually whilst mining takes place, rather than in big groups.
 Heat Generation: Heat generated from mining now occurs gradually rather than in bursts.
Mining Audio: Drill audio is now a constant loop rather than "impacts" every 8 seconds.
 Scrap Exchange Machine: You only have to press a button once to get the item you want, rather than pressing the button, and then needing to press dispense.
 Furnace Fuel: The furnace wont run out of fuel as quickly when water levels are low. It will lose fuel at the same rate when at maximum water levels meaning a little bit of water is more forgiving.
 Ceiling Lights: Updated with a new model. They now hang from the ceiling and gently sway around. 
 Menu Music: Now slightly quieter.
 Anglersaur: Improved head tracking animations to be more accurate when losing sight of the player in darkness.

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.notes:
Scent Grenades have often been confusing and unintuitive to use. They are now reworked to be Decoy Grenades, You throw them, and after a short delay creatures are drawn to the location of the Decoy.

It should now be much simpler to use.
